inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: One out six records reviewed was missing the required annual trainings building safety, allergic reactions, medication administration, and emergency preparedness for the annual year 5/15/2025- 5/15/2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: Based on the evidence gathered during the investigation, it was observed in a video a caregiver changing diapers but did not wash any of the children's hands after the diaper change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: Based on the evidence gathered during the investigation, it was observed in a video that three caregivers were using their personal phones while caring for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - No Long Waiting Periods: Based on the evidence gathered during the investigation, it was observed in a video that children were placed in a feeding table for 30 minutes as a waiting period while caregiver filled out forms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - No Long Waiting Periods (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders: Based on the evidence gathered during the investigation, it was observed in a video that the caregiver gave the children a snack, cookies, placing them on the table without any plates or napkins.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))

occurrences.finding: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance: Based on the preponderance evidence a caregiver restrained a child between a table and herself as a method of guidance and redirection of children. This method of guidance does not encourage self-control.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance (26 TAC §746.2803(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Based on the evidence gathered during the investigation, a child was grabbed and pulled up forcibly by a caregiver as a method of discipline and guidance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Four out five employee records reviewed for their annual year were missing the required trainings  hazardous materials, building safety, allergic reactions, medication administration emergency preparedness, and communicable diseases.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment (Standing or Riding): Merry-go-cycle is within 2-4 ft feet from two metal poles.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment (Standing or Riding) (26 TAC §746.4813(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: Last fire drill and Co Detector checks were documented on 02/2023. Per provider checks and drill were conducted March and for April last week but not documented.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when provider documented the drill and checks during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Caregiver's Hands Washed: Diaper changing mat in the older infant room is torn.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Caregiver's Hands Washed (26 TAC §746.3505(a))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: Trash cans in the restrooms were observed without lids.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Sideboard in the restroom within school-age room #1 is lose exposing some of the wall material.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: Two out of seven staff training records reviewed is missing transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Field Trips - Written List of Children: A written list of the children that attended a field trip and a copy of the allergy plan were not taken on the field trip.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Field Trips - Written List of Children (26 TAC §746.3001(3))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Chipping paint was observed in different classroom including prek and school-age classrooms. One of the prek classroom has missing side boards exposing parts of the wall materials. There is gap on the floor by the door frame diving the two toddler classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: There are protruding bolts underneath the play structure in the playground. There are two utility cables exposed in the playground. There is gap in the fence between 4-5 inches wide.     Note: During inspection provider cut the bolts and fixed the fence.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: A 7 passenger van used for transportation is missing a fire extinguisher.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio for Field Trips - Areas Open to General Public: 30 children ages 2-8yo were supervised by 5 staff members during a field trip to the pool.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio for Field Trips - Areas Open to General Public (26 TAC §746.1801(a))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment (Sitting): Use zones surrounding a spring see-saw and merry-go-cycle did not meet the required six feet.     Note: This was corrected during inspection when provider removed a merry-go-cycle and see-saw from playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment (Sitting) (26 TAC §746.4813(a))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: A 12 passenger van used for transportation is missing an electronic child safety alarm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: No CO detector nor fire extinguisher checks were documented for 2022.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when provider conducted and documented checks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Six out of seven staff training records are missing trainings including the following topics:    -safe sleep/ shaken baby / early brain development  -Hazardous Materials  -Food Allergies  -Administering Medications  -Emergency Prepardness  -Building Safety and Physical Premises Safety  -Communicable Diseases
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: A fan in the infant room was observed with dust build-up and there are two broken tiles in the infant room.    Note: fan was removed from classroom and tiles were covered with a mat during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: This deficiency is not related to  investigation:     Observed a caregiver supervising 5 infants ages ranging from 3 months to 11months.  NOTE: Specified age group is 10 months old. Child/Caregiver ratios 4:1.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: Playground slide structure is missing six inches of loose fill surfacing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: Based on the information gathered, facility did not maintained children's sign in and out for week of 10/4/21 to 10/8/21 for one classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, a child fell down while using a playground structure and caregiver did not have appropriate visual awareness or physical proximity to assist child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))
